#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
nim c -d:release --opt:speed --hints:off --out:app src/app.nim

version       = "0.1.0"
author        = "kvhttp"
description   = "In-memory HTTP/1.1 key-value server"
license       = "MIT"
srcDir        = "src"
bin           = @["app"]

requires "nim >= 2.2.0"
